profile.headline: Full-Stack Developer, Digital Consultant at Lu Daopei International Medical Group
profile.summary:
Full stack web developer with a strong background in leadership and social good initiatives. With experience in JavaScript, React, Redux and Ruby on Rails, I enjoy debugging and optimization. My passion for streamlining process is displayed in my projects which focus on streamlining tasks and presenting essential organized data. My past work experiences include volunteering overseas, inspiring youth to become engaging leaders, and managing the billing system for a medical institution. 

Frontend technologies: 
◦ React.js 
◦ Redux 
◦ Next.js
◦ HTML5, CSS, SASS/SCSS
◦ Bootstrap, Material UI, Semantic UI
◦ React Native

Backend/Cloud/Database technologies: 
◦ Node.js
◦ Apollo
◦ Ruby on Rails
◦ RESTful API / GraphQL API 
◦ Firebase (Functions, Firestore, Authentication, Hosting, Cloud Storage, etc.)
◦ AWS (Amplify, S3, DynamoDB, EC2, Appsync, Lambda, etc.)
◦ Heroku
◦ CI/CD pipelines
◦ SQL / NoSQL

Integrations: 
◦ Stripe, Paypal, Twillio, Google APIs, Algolia, Amplitude, Sendgrid, Slack, Vercel

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.description:
• Owned front-end implementation for vehicle appraisal tool, overview dashboard & inspection filters, translating mockups from product designers to user-facing product features.
• Led building and implementation of a scalable design system of dynamic, reusable, and brand-oriented UI components for seamless implementation by other engineering team members.
• Coordinated multiple project teams to deliver headline product tools by scoping deliverables and allocating tasks across Amazon, Carmax, GM, and more.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description:
‣ Led frontend development across 3 separate projects by managing styling quality control, handling third-party API research and integration, and implementing entire UI/UX pages in close coordination with our founding designer 
‣ Contributed to architectural decisions by participating in backend schema discussions to future proof the database to prioritize flexibility, accommodate future features and reduce relational redundancies
‣ Drove agile development cycle in a variable start-up setting

Products:
Hubble- collaborative research tool to provide real-time, contextual insights from users through prototype based & in-product surveys 
‣ Led Next.js rendering optimization discussions and implementation
‣ Delivered responsive autosave functionality for survey creation workflow, balancing optimistic vs pessimistic rendering while reducing redundant database writes with no extraneous impact to UX
‣ Developed product’s main survey creation interface with live preview and rich, responsive UI

Plexi- Mobile web app for simplified one link checkout for social media sellers 
‣ Built entire customer mobile browser checkout experience with Stripe payment and Shippo shipping API integration along with Material UI and CSS styling

Sneakerlist- iOS live marketplace app for buying and selling limited edition sneakers
‣ Reduced shipping process and customer email response time by 90% by creating CRM/sales management web dashboard for internal team usage with React Data Grid

positions.title: Mission Staff
positions.description:
‣  Drive student engagement for high school cohort through volunteer events and student forums over 3 years
‣  Boost YL Alumni member retention from 4 to 40 participants over 4 years through mentorship and community events
‣  Manage 8 student leaders, implementing best practice group leadership throughout meetings

positions.title: Billing Manager
positions.description:
‣  Push data driven CRM program contributing to highest patient count for an outpatient psychiatric clinic in tri-state area
‣  Initiate EHR implementation over physical record keeping, optimizing employee workflow across board by 40%
‣  Pull ad-hoc reports to facilitate consistent and accurate medical billing
